name: formaproof
description: Evidence-backed patent research and mechanical component inspection using the existing FormaProof MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Find related patent evidence, inspect sources, compare supplied technical features, and explore editable mechanical component templates. Search coverage is partial. Results are preliminary technical research, not a legal opinion or patent clearance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me find patent evidence for my engineering design. Explain which sources were searched and the limitations of each match.
